notes: Monotype Connect desktop UI flows for ingress + app-scoped GraphQL. Push: local/scripts/push_ui_testrail_cases.py --pack ingress --merge-map
preconditions_template:
1. Monotype Connect desktop app installed on macOS (test machine).
2. Test credentials available (OAUTH_USERNAME / OAUTH_PASSWORD).
3. VPN connected; ingress tap queues configured.
4. Capture xCorrelationId (ingress) or GraphQL correlation-id after the action.
5. Emit AUDIT_RESULT with real UUID. Jira: FDC-14091.

cases.title: UI: Monotype Connect login → Preferences → change mac performance mode
cases.custom_preconds:
1. Monotype Connect desktop app installed on macOS.
2. Valid test user credentials.
3. App not logged in OR ready to re-open Preferences.

custom_steps_separated.content: Launch Monotype Connect desktop app on macOS.
custom_steps_separated.expected: App opens to login screen or home.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in with the configured test credentials.
custom_steps_separated.expected: User is authenticated; main app UI is visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Preferences (Monotype Connect menu → Preferences / Settings).
Navigate to General → Performance mode and select a different mode (e.g. Max capacity or Balanced).
custom_steps_separated.expected: Performance mode changes; appSettingsPerformanceModeChanged ingress event fires.

custom_steps_separated.content: Capture xCorrelationId from the ingress audit event → emit AUDIT_RESULT|operation=appSettingsPerformanceModeChanged|correlation_id=<real-uuid>|touchpoint=desktop_ui|source=ingress
custom_steps_separated.expected: AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID; raw+enrich visible in Generation Status.

cases.title: UI: Activate family from global search in Monotype Connect app
cases.custom_preconds:
1. Monotype Connect desktop app installed and logged in.
2. At least one non-activated family available in Discover / Search.

custom_steps_separated.content: Launch Monotype Connect desktop app and log in with test credentials.
custom_steps_separated.expected: App home / Discover view is visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Discover or Search and locate a family that is not activated.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Family card shows inactive / not activated state.

custom_steps_separated.content: Activate the family from the global discover/search view (family card Activate toggle).
custom_steps_separated.expected: Family activates; ActivateFamily GraphQL mutation fires from the app.

custom_steps_separated.content: Network filter operationName=activateFamily → copy response header correlation-id → emit AUDIT_RESULT|operation=activateFamily|correlation_id=<real-uuid>|touchpoint=global_app
custom_steps_separated.expected: GraphQL activateFamily captured; AUDIT_RESULT emitted with real UUID; raw+enrich in Generation Status.
